summary.text: Trish Ladner is a Republican state representative from District 30 who took office in January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Trish Ladner was born in Los Angeles, California, and owns a business, according to Ballotpedia.
She has served on the board of directors of The Mammoth Site, with Visit Hot Springs SD, with the Hot Springs Chamber of Commerce, and with Southern Hills Economic Development.

In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a conservative Republican who believes in limited government, low taxes and less regulation, and said she built a marketing business from the ground up.
Ladner assumed office in the South Dakota House of Representatives on January 12, 2021, succeeding Julie Frye-Mueller.
In the 2025-2026 session, she serves on the House Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee and the House Local Government Committee.
